headlines.title: U.S. Air Force removes all bombers from British air base targeted in a suspected terrorist plot
headlines.description: The bombers at RAF Fairford “have been re-deployed to their home stations in the United States,” a Pentagon official told NBC News.

headlines.title: How the shooting death of a Houston father is igniting Latino politics in Texas
headlines.description: Lorenzo Salgado Araujo was killed on his way to work by ICE agents, who said he used his vehicle as a weapon. The community is demanding justice.

headlines.title: Poll: Latino voters swing away from Trump and Republicans
headlines.description: Democrats have a significant lead among Latino voters in 2026 amid economic concerns, according to the NBC News/Telemundo poll.

headlines.title: Can Democrats Mess With (Republican) Texas?
headlines.description: State Rep. Gina Hinojosa (D-TX) says the economy and jobs are more important than culture issues in the race for Texas Governor

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
headlines.description: The woman who alleges she was sexually assaulted by Cornell University fraternity members has received threats pressuring her to drop her lawsuit, her attorney said.

headlines.title: Cornell rape accuser faces threats demanding she drop her lawsuit, attorney says
headlines.description: The accuser’s attorney said that women mistakenly identified as Jane Doe have also received threats and that he received one Sunday morning.

headlines.title: Accused Cornell Fraternity Member Confronted on Camera
headlines.description: Video shows a dramatic confrontation with Gillio Lopes, one of the men accused in the Cornell sexual assault case. It’s the latest fallout as more revelations surface about the local district attorney’s actions before deciding not to move ahead with criminal charges. NBC’s Valerie Castro reports for Sunday TODAY.

headlines.title: ‘It’s not enough to not rape somebody’: How parents are talking to kids about Cornell
headlines.description: Parents are using Jane Doe’s case to talk to their sons about resisting peer pressure and stepping in when something’s wrong, even if it means challenging their friends.

headlines.title: Early indications suggest Flydubai co-pilot acted alone in attack, officials say
headlines.description: Officials cautioned that the investigation remains in its early stages and that possible links to an organization or foreign government haven’t been definitively ruled out.

headlines.title: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson exits game vs. Titans with ankle injury
headlines.description: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson missed the second half of the Ravens’ 24-18 win against the Tennessee Titans on Sunday because of an ankle injury.

headlines.title: John Kennedy says he’s considering running for president: ‘Why not me on a rainy day?’
headlines.description: Sen. John Kennedy (R-La.) tells Meet the Press he’s considering running for president, but says he hasn’t made a decision yet.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.
